gloss: one grain; one drop; a single small round thing

definitions.gloss: one grain; one drop; a single small round item
definitions.explanation: A single instance of something small and roundish: a grain of rice, a drop of water, a single berry, a pill, etc.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}を{一粒|ひとつぶ}{飲|の}んだ。
{涙|なみだ}が{一粒|ひとつぶ}{頬|ほお}を{伝|つた}った。
examples.english: A single tear ran down her cheek.

examples.japanese: {大切|たいせつ}に{育|そだ}てた{米|こめ}は、{一粒|ひとつぶ}も{無駄|むだ}にしたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to waste even a single grain of the carefully cultivated rice.

notes:
{一|ひと} (one) + {粒|つぶ} (grain, drop, particle). The counter {粒|つぶ} applies to small, roundish items.

COUNTING WITH {粒|つぶ}:
- {一粒|ひとつぶ}: one grain
- {二粒|ふたつぶ}: two grains
- {三粒|みつぶ}: three grains
- {何粒|なんつぶ}: how many grains

TYPICAL USES:
- {米|こめ}{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a grain of rice
- {薬|くすり}{一粒|ひとつぶ}: one pill, one tablet
- {雨粒|あまつぶ}{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a single raindrop
- {真珠|しんじゅ}{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a single pearl
- ぶどう{一粒|ひとつぶ}: a single grape (one berry from a bunch)

FIGURATIVE: {一粒|ひとつぶ}も {無駄|むだ}にしない ('not waste a single grain') is a common expression about cherishing every bit.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一房|ひとふさ}: a cluster — used for the whole bunch that contains many {粒|つぶ}
- {一滴|いってき}: a drop — specifically for liquid
